correctness.rationale: Every partial isometry of rank >=2 has exactly one affine extension; all lower-rank overcounts are explicitly subtracted. The criterion for commuting with an idempotent is equality of membership along arrows, giving 3 for each translation forest edge and 10 for each reflected two-point orbit. The exact mixed-pair formula is verified against independent direct enumeration for n=2..7. The asymptotic bound uses distinct Bernoulli-bit comparisons across at least n/20 central coordinates and O(n²) affine models, proving exponentially small non-idempotent commuting counts; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The commutativity degree of a finite inverse monoid is a natural global algebraic invariant not determined by rank or fixedpoint enumerators. The full monoid adds reflection 2-orbits, giving an exact 10-weight centralizer term and a new limiting probability 1/36 distinct from the order-preserving submonoid’s 1/9. This is a coherent family-wide pair-incidence determination, not an isolated computation or mere re-expression of the known cardinality.
